Dual-tone text follows the system for its light/dark fill and adds a thin opposite-color outline, so it remains legible when an app uses the opposite theme. Both background styles add only one physical pixel above and below their content.
Admin keys query organization costs and limits; project keys are validation-only.

The common sk-proj- key is a project key. It can call models but cannot read organization-level costs or limits. Automatic queries require an sk-admin- admin key created by an organization owner. With a project key, enter the balance under Alerts and manual balance.
Project key detected: the app will validate the key but will not query a balance automatically.
The balance endpoint requires a Management Key. Inference keys may return 403.
Reads the total balance from the official /user/info endpoint.
A standard key reads the balance directly; Chinese CNY and international USD endpoints are detected automatically.

A pay-as-you-go sk- key is validated with the official model list. Balance and usage are visible in the MiMo console, but no public query API is available, so set a manual balance. tp- Token Plan keys are not supported.
Regular keys do not expose remaining balance. A manual balance can be set after validation.

Supports new AQ. and legacy AIza keys. Free and postpaid plans have no fixed remaining balance, so leave manual balance empty and show key validity only. Prepaid users can copy available credit from AI Studio Usage and Limits.
Regular keys do not expose remaining balance. A manual balance can be set after validation.

View ChatGPT/Codex plan usage (unofficial interface, off by default)

This feature requires signing in to ChatGPT inside the app. A login session is as sensitive as a password; a compromised device, WebView, or website could expose information or your account. The interface may change, stop working, or require sign-in again at any time. BalanceIsland stores only plan type, percentages, reset times, and update time locally, but cannot guarantee the behavior of the third-party web page.

Only unauthenticated HTTP proxies are supported. A proxy can see connection destinations and, with its CA installed, may decrypt the session. Use only a trusted proxy. Emulators commonly reach the computer at 10.0.2.2.
